pages.text: Items whose tooltip shows the "$(bold)Seasoning$()" label, and holding $(bold)Shift$() over them reveals their effects, are all seasonings.

When you $(bold)eat food$() with a seasoning in your $(bold)off hand$(), you gain that seasoning's buff from this meal.$(br2)Seasonings used while $(bold)stir-frying$() also affect the buffs of your dishes (only for freely combined process dishes).
